tools.purpose: Decide whether a JAR is a Java agent, verify the declared class really declares premain with the right descriptor, and list the bootstrap load-path entries.
tools.expect: manifest attributes, per-class presence and premain check, Boot-Class-Path rows, verdict

notes: Read-only and offline. Manifest values are re-joined using the 72-byte continuation rule, which is where hand-edited agents usually break. A Boot-Class-Path entry outside the JAR is called out because the JVM loads it before application code runs.
